summary.tldr: Bans glyphosate as a pest control product and cancels registrations for products that contain it.
what_it_does: Adds glyphosate to the Pest Control Products Act ban list, so no person may manufacture, possess, handle, store, transport, import, distribute or use it as a pest control product.
Cancels the registration of products containing glyphosate under the Pest Control Products Act.
Brings the ban into force on the first anniversary of royal assent.
who_it_affects: Businesses that store or transport glyphosate
summary.background: It amends the Pest Control Products Act.
